description.zh:
报警生效的结束时间。取值范围：0~23。

例如：`AlertConfig.StartTime`为0，`AlertConfig.EndTime`为22，表示报警生效时间为00:00:00至22:00:00。

>如果报警不在生效时间内，则超过阈值也不会发送报警通知。
description.en:
The end time when the alert takes effect. Valid values: 0 to 23.

For example, if AlertConfig.StartTime is set to 0 and AlertConfig.EndTime is set to 22, the alert is effective from 00:00:00 to 22:00:00.

> If the alert is not within the effective period, no alert notification is sent even if the threshold is exceeded.

报警通知类型。取值：

<props="china">- 2：电话+短信+邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- 1：短信+邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- 0：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>


<props="intl">0：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="partner">0：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>
description.en:
The alert notification type. Valid values:

<props="china">- 2: Phone call + text message + email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

<props="china">- 0: Email + DingTalk chatbot.</props>

description.zh: 通道沉默时间。单位：秒，默认值：86400（1天）。
description.en: The mute period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (1 day).

description.zh:
报警生效的开始时间。取值范围：0~23。

例如：`AlertConfig.StartTime`为0，`AlertConfig.EndTime`为22，表示报警生效时间为00:00:00至22:00:00。

>如果报警不在生效时间内，则超过阈值也不会发送报警通知。
description.en:
The start time when the alert takes effect. Valid values: 0 to 23.

For example, if AlertConfig.StartTime is set to 0 and AlertConfig.EndTime is set to 22, the alert is effective from 00:00:00 to 22:00:00.

> If the alert is not within the effective period, no alert notification is sent even if the threshold is exceeded.

description.zh: URL回调地址。
description.en: The webhook address.

description.zh: 报警配置列表。
description.en: The alert configuration list.

description.zh:
报警统计方法。N的取值范围：1~21。不同监控项的统计方法取值如下：

- HttpStatus：Value。
- HttpLatency：Average。
- TelnetStatus：Value。
- TelnetLatency：Average。
- PingLostRate：Average。

>状态码类的统计方法为原始值（Value），延时时间或丢包率的统计方法为平均值（Average）。
description.en:
The statistical method for the alert. Valid values of N: 1 to 21. The valid values vary based on the metric:

- HttpStatus: Value.
- HttpLatency: Average.
- TelnetStatus: Value.
- TelnetLatency: Average.
- PingLostRate: Average.

> The statistical method for status code metrics is the original value (Value). The statistical method for latency or packet loss rate metrics is the average value (Average).

description.zh:
报警的监控项。N的取值范围：1~21。取值：

- HttpStatus：HTTP状态码。
- HttpLatency：HTTP等待时间。
- TelnetStatus：TELNET状态码。
- TelnetLatency：TELNET等待时间。
- PingLostRate：PING丢包率。
description.en:
The metric for the alert. Valid values of N: 1 to 21. Valid values:

- HttpStatus: HTTP status code.
- HttpLatency: HTTP latency.
- TelnetStatus: Telnet status code.
- TelnetLatency: Telnet latency.
- PingLostRate: PING packet loss rate.

The comparison operator for the alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 21. Valid values:

- `>`
- `>=`
- `<`
- `<=`
- `=`

description.zh: 报警重试次数。N的取值范围：1~21。
description.en: The number of alert retries. Valid values of N: 1 to 21.

description.zh: 报警阈值。N的取值范围：1~21。
description.en: The alert threshold. Valid values of N: 1 to 21.

description.zh: 报警触发目标。
description.en: The alert trigger targets.

description.zh: 应用分组ID。
description.en: The ID of the application group.

description.zh: 可用性监控任务ID。
description.en: The ID of the availability monitoring task.

description.zh:
发起探测的ECS实例列表。N的取值范围：1~21。

> 当`TaskScope`为`GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE`时，需要设置该参数。
description.en:
The list of ECS instances that initiate detection. Valid values of N: 1 to 21.

> If `TaskScope` is set to `GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE`, you must set this parameter.

description.zh: 可用性监控任务名称。
description.en: The name of the availability monitoring task.

description.zh:
HTTP请求的Header。格式为`参数名:参数`，多个参数之间用回车符分隔，例如：
```
params1:value1
params2:value2
```
description.en:
The header of the HTTP request. The format is `Parameter:Value`. Separate multiple parameters with carriage returns. Example:
```
params1:value1
params2:value2
```

description.zh:
探测类型的方法。取值：

- GET
- POST
- HEAD

>如果探测任务类型为HTTP，则需要设置该参数。关于探测任务类型的设置方法，请参见[CreateHostAvailability](~~115317~~)。
description.en:
The method for the detection type. Valid values:

- GET
- POST
- HEAD

> If the detection task type is HTTP, you must set this parameter. For more information about how to set the detection task type, see [CreateHostAvailability](~~115317~~).

description.zh:
匹配HTTP响应内容的报警规则。取值：
- true：如果HTTP响应内容包含设置的报警规则，则报警。
- false：如果HTTP响应内容不包含设置的报警规则，则报警。

>如果探测任务类型为HTTP，则需要设置该参数。关于探测任务类型的设置方法，请参见[CreateHostAvailability](~~115317~~)。
description.en:
The alert rule for matching HTTP response content. Valid values:
- true: An alert is triggered if the HTTP response content contains the specified alert rule.
- false: An alert is triggered if the HTTP response content does not contain the specified alert rule.

> If the detection task type is HTTP, you must set this parameter. For more information about how to set the detection task type, see [CreateHostAvailability](~~115317~~).

description.zh: HTTP探测类型探测请求的Post内容。
description.en: The POST content of the HTTP detection request.

description.zh:
HTTP探测类型的响应字符集。

> 仅支持UTF-8。
description.en:
The response character set for the HTTP detection type.

> Only UTF-8 is supported.

description.zh: HTTP探测类型探测响应的Post内容。
description.en: The content to match in the HTTP detection response.

description.zh: HTTP、Telnet探测类型的探测URI地址。
description.en: The URI for HTTP or Telnet detection types.

The detection frequency. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 15, 30, 60, 120, 300, 900, 1800, and 3600.

> Only CloudMonitor agent 3.5.1 or later supports this parameter.

description.zh:
探测的域名或地址。

>如果探测任务类型为PING，则需要设置该参数。关于探测任务类型的设置方法，请参见[CreateHostAvailability](~~115317~~)。
description.en:
The domain name or address to detect.

> If the detection task type is PING, you must set this parameter. For more information about how to set the detection task type, see [CreateHostAvailability](~~115317~~).

description.zh:
可用性监控任务的探测范围。取值：

- GROUP：表示将当前应用分组内的所有ECS实例作为探测任务的探针。
- GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE：表示将当前应用分组内的指定ECS实例作为探测任务的探针。设置该参数时，需要同时设置InstanceList（发起探测的ECS实例列表）。
description.en:
The detection scope of the availability monitoring task. Valid values:

- GROUP: All ECS instances in the current application group are used as probes for the detection task.
- GROUP_SPEC_INSTANCE: Specified ECS instances in the current application group are used as probes for the detection task. If you set this parameter to this value, you must also set InstanceList to specify the ECS instances that initiate detection.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，将应用分组`123456`中可用性监控任务`12345`的名称修改为`task2`。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to change the name of availability monitoring task `12345` in application group `123456` to `task2`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms modify-host-availability --group-id 123456 --id 12345 --task-name task2 --task-scope GROUP --task-option-http-uri https://www.aliyun.com_telnet://127.0.0.1:80 --task-option-telnet-or-ping-host www.aliyun.com --task-option-http-response-charset UTF-8 --task-option-http-post-content params1=value1 --task-option-http-response-match-content ok --task-option-http-method GET --task-option-http-negative true --task-option-http-header params1:value1 --task-option-interval 60 --alert-config-notify-type 0 --alert-config-start-time 0 --alert-config-end-time 22 --alert-config-silence-time 86400 --alert-config-web-hook https://www.aliyun.com/webhook.json --alert-config-escalation-list Operator=example-string MetricName=HttpStatus Times=3 Value=3 Aggregate=Value --instance-list 2 --alert-config-target-list JsonParams=customField1_:_value1_,_customField2_:_.name Level=INFO_,_WARN_,_CRITICAL Id=1 Arn=acs:mns:cn-hangzhou:111:/queues/test/message --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms ModifyHostAvailability --region cn-hangzhou --TaskOption.TelnetOrPingHost 'www.aliyun.com' --TaskOption.HttpPostContent 'params1=value1' --AlertConfig.NotifyType 0 --AlertConfigEscalationList.1.Value 3 --AlertConfigTargetList.1.Id 1 --TaskOption.Interval 60 --AlertConfig.EndTime 22 --AlertConfigEscalationList.1.Operator 'example-string' --TaskOption.HttpResponseMatchContent ok --TaskOption.HttpHeader 'params1:value1' --AlertConfigTargetList.1.Arn 'acs:mns:cn-hangzhou:111:/queues/test/message' --AlertConfigTargetList.1.Level 'INFO_,_WARN_,_CRITICAL' --AlertConfig.SilenceTime 86400 --TaskScope GROUP --TaskOption.HttpMethod GET --AlertConfig.WebHook 'https://www.aliyun.com/webhook.json' --GroupId 123456 --AlertConfig.StartTime 0 --AlertConfigEscalationList.1.Times 3 --TaskOption.HttpResponseCharset 'UTF-8' --AlertConfigEscalationList.1.Aggregate Value --AlertConfigTargetList.1.JsonParams 'customField1_:_value1_,_customField2_:_.name' --TaskName task2 --TaskOption.HttpURI 'https://www.aliyun.com_telnet://127.0.0.1:80' --AlertConfigEscalationList.1.MetricName HttpStatus --InstanceList.1 2 --Id 12345 --TaskOption.HttpNegative true --method POST --force
